scope: Ten Showcase scenes, current foundations, prepared fonts, native/full source-clock Dock stories. This does not establish cold-route, trusted-input, recipe, contrast or site-wide acceptance.
methodology: Each completed sample and compressed trace stays in its own run directory; no older run is overwritten.
Mesh runs for twelve seconds to include its original breath. Other scenes run for eight seconds. Paths completes one six-second replay; other scenes receive six Dock actions.
Fonts are prepared before mounting and CPU throttling. First trace Paint and two-frame readiness include mount and image decoding; route and font transfer are excluded.
The live page uses foundations.css. Frozen style.css is not a substitute for current Stage styles.
The sampler uses requestAnimationFrame without layout polling during the story. It records initialization and story long tasks and checks disposal.
Run sequentially without other heavy agent checks. Other applications are not controlled. Measurements do not automatically pass a timing gate.

interruptedRun.reason: Known harness mismatch: the SVG-only Paths inspector has no painter.dead property. Stop owned measurement before changing the source-bound profiler; retain every completed case and the first 317.686ms Dot Field paint outlier.

notes: Frame rates count source requestAnimationFrame intervals; compositor presentation rate is not independently established by these samples.
All raw traces, completed/partial reports, experimental sources and pixel diagnostics remain archived privately. No trial was deployed.

Older Mesh compact CPU4 timing at 30.38fps remains historical evidence. Current full Mesh keeps the same 400x320 model and 5044 paint commands. Browser and shared stylesheet differ; these observations do not establish the cause of the timing difference.

The interrupted run stopped only owned profiling processes to fix a harness mismatch: SVG-only Paths has no painter.dead API. Its root lifetime, frames, queue, captures and animations remain checked. Every completed sample and outlier is retained.
The current forty-case run uses the final profiler; previous harness source versions are preserved by hash. No component source changed between these measurements.
Prepared fonts and local Stage mounts exclude route/font transfer. Cold-route, complete 520-component CPU4 performance, recipe and manual accessibility acceptance remain open.
